reference.rule: The approved reference is the visual source of truth. It is a blueprint, not a background image or poster layer.

hardRules: Do not redesign or substitute the approved composition.
Do not embed the full reference image as the website implementation.
Preserve approved imagery and identity assets wherever available.
Do not invent an alternate mobile composition.
Do not touch production during Run 2.
Do not certify visual success by human assertion alone.

visualLoop.acceptance: Continue correction until configured visual threshold passes at certified desktop and mobile viewports.

run2Exit: visual differences are reported rather than guessed
